messages:
lee: Follow-up from the postmortem: we need owners + dates for rollout safety fixes. Keeping notes here so tracker items are clear.

anika: Agreed. Short list: hotfix to cap rollout size, POC auto-rollback, and region warmup gating.

rohit: I'll own the hotfix cap. Plan: default server-side cap = 10% unless tenant overrides, block >20% ramps without manual approval. Target deploy: 2026-03-30.

ops-bot: incident note: canary continued ramp after p95 spike at 02:05 UTC; manual pause at 02:11 UTC prevented wider impact.

eng-oncall: recurring pattern: new-region ramps trigger cache miss cascades. Suggest add a pre-ramp warmup check that verifies KV hit-rate > 80% and model-init latency < 500ms for 2 mins.

anika: I'll prototype the rollback decision service spec. Requirements: require two independent signals (errors + latency or errors + eval), cooldown 1h, dry-run mode, telemetry for audits. POC due 2026-04-10.

console-bot: UX ask: show "safety controls" in rollout config (max_percent, regions_allowed, auto_rollback_enabled) and flag history with reasons. Mock by 2026-04-05.

lee: action items:
- ENGINF-710: Rollout cap hotfix  owner: rohit  due: 2026-03-30
- ENGINF-711: Rollback decision POC  owner: anika  due: 2026-04-10
- ENGINF-712: Region warmup gating  owner: eng-oncall  due: 2026-04-07
- ENGINF-713: Console safety UX  owner: console-bot  due: 2026-04-05

rohit: will open PR for the hotfix and include unit tests that simulate new-region ramps.

anika: I'll add example YAML for policy in the ticket, and wire up a dry-run flag first.

lee: Great. Weekly progress updates in the tracker please, and ping #eng-platform for review.
